title: Beating GPT-5.6 Sol on retrieval with 100x cheaper open models
summary: Neon's Castform demonstrates that open-source models, when combined with efficient retrieval techniques, can outperform frontier models like GPT-5.6 Sol on retrieval tasks at a fraction of the cost. The article details a 100x cost reduction while maintaining or exceeding performance, highlighting practical strategies for building cost-effective AI systems.
